  • Method Details

    • merge

      public static AnnotationMetadata merge(AnnotationMetadata... levelsLastWins)
      Merges levels of metadata into one view in which every level is declared. The levels are read as they are, not copied: a shared generated metadata is never altered.
      • A single occurrence, as AnnotationSource.findAnnotation(String) and the member accessors such as AnnotationMetadata.stringValue(String) read it, is the annotation of every level holding it with its members merged: a member the last level sets wins. Its retained stereotypes are those of the last level holding the annotation.
      • The occurrences, as AnnotationMetadata.getAnnotationValuesByName(String), AnnotationMetadata.getAnnotationValuesByType(Class) and the plural member accessors such as AnnotationMetadata.stringValues(String, String) read them, are those of every level, the last level first, whether or not the annotation is repeatable.
      • AnnotationMetadata.getDeclaredMetadata() merges what every level declares, leaving out what a level inherits.
      • The member accessors of the merged view resolve placeholders and expressions as each level does. An annotation present on several levels is returned by AnnotationSource.findAnnotation(String) as a plain value of the merged members, which does not resolve them: read its members through the merged view, or merge metadata that is not environment aware.

      An empty level is skipped. No level gives AnnotationMetadata.EMPTY_METADATA, a single one is returned itself.

      Parameters:
      levelsLastWins - The levels, the one to win last
      Returns:
      The merged metadata

    • synthesize

      public static <T extends Annotation> T synthesize(Class<T> annotationType, @Nullable AnnotationValue<T> value)
      Materializes an annotation value as an instance of its annotation type: with the generated annotation builder of the type when there is one and the value has no expressions to evaluate, else with a proxy. Members the value does not set answer their defaults; the internal members and the retained stereotypes are left out.
      Type Parameters:
      T - The annotation type
      Parameters:
      annotationType - The annotation type
      value - The value, or null for an instance with the defaults
      Returns:
      The annotation
